out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS REVIEWED REQUIREMENTS WITH CFM.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EQUIPMENT PUT THROUGH WASH, RINSE, SANITIZE SOLUTIONS IN 3 COMP SINK.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: in meat cutting room: meat saw, knife in box on wall, containers under prep table, oyster knives in pantry area (CDI).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: packaged spinach on a shelf under the steam table (61°F), crème fresh (59°F) in bottle in container with little ice.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. SPINACH DISCARDED. MORE ICE ADDED TO CRÈME FRESH AND DISCARD WITHIN 4 HOURS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control:citrus honey, lobster broth, crème fresh, steak dry rub, grilled lemons.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit.

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): Citrus honey, lobster broth, grilled lemons, steak dry rub, crème fresh.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS TO PROVIDE POLICY.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed vacuum sealed packages of sea bass in the walk in cooler to thaw.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INFORMED CFM THAT PACKAGES MUST BE CUT PRIOR TO THAWING IN WIC.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. EHS observed numerous fruit flies in the semi -enclosed trash/ grease disposal/ storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The high temp dishwasher was not functioning properly.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. A TECH WAS CALLED TO SERVICE DISHWASHER.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: sides of the fryer, speed rack near produce WIC, exterior of cornmeal container, spray bottle in meat cutting cooler (CDI).
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Grease disposal container in the semi enclosed area has an accumulation of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Soiled receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent them from developing a buildup of soil or becoming attractants for insects and rodents. THE CAPITAL GRILLE #8068 (Inspection Date: 08/04/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the employee unisex restroom.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Purchase lidded trash can for employee unisex restroom.
